world: K=16 latent bits in four 4-bit units; one noisy factor (intra-unit unary/pair/triple, or cross-unit pair/triple on one of two active unit pairs) and one parity query per step; active cross pairs redrawn every slow epoch
lambda_unit: utility per millisecond of modelled kernel time (objective_kernel) or of modelled kernel plus measured routing time and amortised training time (objective_total)
gamma_meaning: utility charged for launching an operator kernel not yet launched in this step for the batch (fragmentation)
mu_meaning: utility per nat of estimated discarded correlation when answering from local block state
timescales: fast: every step absorb evidence into block tables and answer the query; slow: every 8 steps merge the unit pair with the largest estimated discarded correlation (sum of ln2-H(e) over cross sensors) if above merge_tau, blocks capped at two units; global: exact inference over the relevant component whenever the router requests it
routers: fixed_local, fixed_local_nomerge (slow timescale disabled), fixed_bp, fixed_exact, random, symbolic (thresholds tuned on dev), symbolic_j (J with regret = kappa * KL_hat fitted on dev), learned (MLP regret model fitted on dev), oracle (true regret; privileged)

gates.E1: the exact operator equals an independent fg.variable_elimination over the relevant component; local equals exact when no cross factors are pending (tests/test_mesh15.py)
gates.P1: learned promotes only if it wins more held-out conditions (rho x noise) than it loses on objective_total against the strongest symbolic router selected on dev (tuned symbolic or the best fixed policy)

cost_model: kernel seconds = a_op + b_op * work, fitted by least squares to timed batched NumPy kernels at batch sizes 1..256 (cost_model15.json); a calibrated model, not a per-step measurement
no_tuning: model15.pkl, model15_summary.json, cost_model15.json and this file are committed before receipt15_test.json is generated
